task.summary: Fix `.drain()` so that an `undefined` value stored in the queue is yielded like any other queued value and does not end draining early. After draining, every element that followed the `undefined` value must also have been yielded and the queue must be empty.

args: try{const{pathToFileURL}=await import('node:url');const{resolve}=await import('node:path');const Queue=(await import(pathToFileURL(resolve('index.js')).href)).default;const q=new Queue();q.enqueue('first');q.enqueue(undefined);q.enqueue('last');const out=[...q.drain()];const ok=out.length===3&&out[0]==='first'&&out[1]===undefined&&out[2]==='last'&&q.size===0&&[...q].length===0;process.exitCode=ok?0:1}catch{process.exitCode=1}
